title: Staff
description: How staff answer requests for 5 to 8 people. The time axis is the moment the request was made, in Asia/Tbilisi.

list.name: location
list.label: Location
list.query: SELECT address AS __text, id AS __value FROM locations ORDER BY created_at
list.definition: SELECT address AS __text, id AS __value FROM locations ORDER BY created_at

panels.title: Pending requests now
panels.description: Requests waiting for a decision right now, whatever the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Pending"
FROM bookings b
JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
WHERE b.party_size > 4
  AND b.status = 'PENDING'
  AND t.location_id IN ($location)

panels.title: Time to decision (median, p90)
panels.description: From the request to a staff member's approval or rejection. Automatic rejections and requests that lost their table to another request are left out.

targets.rawSql:
WITH requests AS (
  SELECT b.created_at, b.decided_at,
         CASE
           WHEN b.status = 'PENDING' THEN 'pending'
           WHEN b.status = 'REJECTED' AND b.decided_by_id IS NULL THEN 'automatic'
           WHEN b.status = 'REJECTED' AND EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM bookings a
             WHERE a.table_id = b.table_id
               AND a.decided_at = b.decided_at
               AND a.decided_by_id IS NOT NULL
               AND a.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED')
           ) THEN 'competitor'
           WHEN b.status = 'REJECTED' THEN 'rejected'
           WHEN b.decided_by_id IS NOT NULL AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED') THEN 'approved'
           WHEN b.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 'withdrawn'
         END AS outcome
  FROM bookings b
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  WHERE b.party_size > 4
    AND $__timeFilter(b.created_at)
    AND t.location_id IN ($location)
)
SELECT extract(epoch FROM percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY decided_at - created_at))::float AS "Median",
       extract(epoch FROM percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY decided_at - created_at))::float AS "p90"
FROM requests
WHERE outcome IN ('approved', 'rejected')

panels.title: Approval rate
panels.description: Approved requests over approved plus those a staff member rejected. A request cancelled after its approval still counts as approved.

targets.rawSql:
WITH requests AS (
  SELECT b.created_at, b.decided_at,
         CASE
           WHEN b.status = 'PENDING' THEN 'pending'
           WHEN b.status = 'REJECTED' AND b.decided_by_id IS NULL THEN 'automatic'
           WHEN b.status = 'REJECTED' AND EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM bookings a
             WHERE a.table_id = b.table_id
               AND a.decided_at = b.decided_at
               AND a.decided_by_id IS NOT NULL
               AND a.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED')
           ) THEN 'competitor'
           WHEN b.status = 'REJECTED' THEN 'rejected'
           WHEN b.decided_by_id IS NOT NULL AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED') THEN 'approved'
           WHEN b.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 'withdrawn'
         END AS outcome
  FROM bookings b
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  WHERE b.party_size > 4
    AND $__timeFilter(b.created_at)
    AND t.location_id IN ($location)
)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'approved')::float
       / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome IN ('approved', 'rejected')), 0) AS "Approval rate"
FROM requests

panels.title: Auto-rejected share
panels.description: Requests rejected automatically 2 hours before their start, over all decided requests.

targets.rawSql:
WITH requests AS (
  SELECT b.created_at, b.decided_at,
         CASE
           WHEN b.status = 'PENDING' THEN 'pending'
           WHEN b.status = 'REJECTED' AND b.decided_by_id IS NULL THEN 'automatic'

           ) THEN 'competitor'
           WHEN b.status = 'REJECTED' THEN 'rejected'

           WHEN b.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 'withdrawn'

panels.title: Requests per day
panels.description: Requests by the day they were made, split by outcome. A request loses to another request when staff approve a competing one for the same table and time.

targets.rawSql:
WITH requests AS (
  SELECT b.created_at, b.decided_at,
         CASE
           WHEN b.status = 'PENDING' THEN 'pending'
           WHEN b.status = 'REJECTED' AND b.decided_by_id IS NULL THEN 'automatic'
           WHEN b.status = 'REJECTED' AND EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM bookings a
             WHERE a.table_id = b.table_id
               AND a.decided_at = b.decided_at
               AND a.decided_by_id IS NOT NULL
               AND a.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED')
           ) THEN 'competitor'
           WHEN b.status = 'REJECTED' THEN 'rejected'
           WHEN b.decided_by_id IS NOT NULL AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED') THEN 'approved'
           WHEN b.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 'withdrawn'
         END AS outcome
  FROM bookings b
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  WHERE b.party_size > 4
    AND $__timeFilter(b.created_at)
    AND t.location_id IN ($location)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at, 'Asia/Tbilisi') AS time,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'approved') AS "Approved",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'rejected') AS "Rejected by staff",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'competitor') AS "Lost to another request",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'automatic') AS "Auto-rejected",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'pending') AS "Pending",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'withdrawn') AS "Cancelled before a decision"
FROM requests
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
